scene: Wind whips your scarf atop the tether tower above the field.
picture: Side-view on the wooden observation platform high up. On the far left sits a brass telescope on a tripod. The lanky boy in his orange vest and scarf stands centre. To the right, a small docked blimp cabin floats level with the deck, and on the far right hangs a descending zipline cable.
shown: A brass telescope fixed on a pivot on the far left railing.nn
A jaunty pilot in goggles sitting in an airship cabin on the right.nn
